title: Vietnam Group Tour South to North
alt: Cable car towers above the forest at Ba Na Hills
transport: Two domestic flights, coach travel and guided tours

activities.match: Full Day Cu Chi Tunnels and Mekong Delta Tour

program.name: Ho Chi Minh City
program.description: Two nights in District 1, with the Cu Chi tunnels and the Mekong Delta in one long day.

activities.description: The old trading town on foot as the lanterns come on, through the Japanese bridge, the assembly halls and the merchant houses.

activities.name: Ba Na Hills full day with lunch
activities.description: The long cable car up to Ba Na, the Golden Bridge held up by two stone hands, the French village and gardens, with lunch at the top.

program.name: Da Nang
program.description: The flight to the central coast for two nights by the beach, with Hoi An by lantern light and a full day at Ba Na.

program.name: Hanoi

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: One long day in the south does both Cu Chi and the delta, which frees up the rest of the week for the centre and the bay.
expert.tip: The Hoi An walk here is in the evening, which is the right call. Lanterns on the water beat the midday heat.

summary: A week south to north with a group: two nights in Saigon with a long day covering the Cu Chi tunnels and the Mekong Delta, two in Da Nang with Hoi An by lantern light and a full day at Ba Na Hills, then Hanoi and a full day cruise on Halong Bay.
included: Included: 6 nights at four star hotels with daily breakfast and full board in Da Nang; two domestic flights; all coach travel and transfers; one long guided day covering the Cu Chi tunnels and the delta; a Hoi An walking tour; a full day at Ba Na Hills with lunch; a full day cruise on Halong Bay with lunch.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
